PPA: https://launchpad.net/~ghadi-rahme/+archive/ubuntu/gnutls-stonking-2-lp2155651

New Changes:
-  Added a new patch (d/p/fix_test-getaddrinfo.patch) to ignore DNS name resolution errors in tests due to launchpad builders not giving network access to machines when building.

Basic Test:
$ gnutls-cli canonical.com

More complicated test:
- Steps for a more complicated test which tests the pkcs11 capability can be found in the [Test Plan] section of this bug: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/gnutls28/+bug/2150202

Info:
- This gnutls version contains a pkcs11 fix for: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/gnutls28/+bug/2150202

+From b961451513479cd9cb67cd99a002039ebad30f1f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Ghadi Elie Rahme <ghadi.rahme@canonical.com>
+Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 19:12:37 +0300
+Subject: [PATCH] Avoid test failure when DNS is not reachable
+
+Some CI environments have a local network attached but wihtout internet access.
+This causes test-getaddrinfo to fail since it cannot do DNS name resolution.
+Avoid failing if EAI_NONAME is returned
+---
+ src/gl/tests/test-getaddrinfo.c | 2 +-
+ 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/src/gl/tests/test-getaddrinfo.c b/src/gl/tests/test-getaddrinfo.c
+index 83e52d109..eb70d1a01 100644
+--- a/src/gl/tests/test-getaddrinfo.c
++++ b/src/gl/tests/test-getaddrinfo.c
+@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@ simple (int pass, char const *host, char const *service)
+       /* EAI_AGAIN is returned if no network is available. Don't fail
+          the test merely because someone is down the country on their
+          in-law's farm. */
+-      if (res == EAI_AGAIN)
++      if (res == EAI_AGAIN || res == EAI_NONAME)
+         {
+           skip++;
+           fprintf (stderr, "skipping getaddrinfo test: no network?\n");
+-- 
+2.53.0
